_note: Question set (38 of the ~90 targeted). Every gold and alternative answer was checked on Oct 27, 2026 against the verbatim passages in docs.json and, for values that only exist in a newer version (C2, C4), against the official source behind registry.json; `verified: true` records that check. Freeze this file in Git before the main sweep. `corpus` lists the doc_ids that are 'in the corpus' for the question (passages from other families' default_pool docs are added as distractors). `accept` / `alt` are regexes over the normalised answer (lower-case, '$' and thousands separators removed) and are only set when the answer is numeric or a short identifier; everything else is labelled by the judge. For C5, alt_answer is the newer version's value, i.e. the wrong 'correction'.
